ordering: Complete this six-policy closed-loop ablation before defining or running V1.1.
monitoring: All paired weight comparisons use the original mixture BF alarm. V0 native parity, with its original threshold rule, is saved separately.
onset_scoring: At the original event's last update, compare each active onset posterior mass and the aggregate mass for no active event. Count a no-active decision as an error. Also retain active-only MAP and the mass on the true onset.
sample_scope: Development and regression only. No fresh randomness for this phase.
